events.verdict: Coulibaly (WAS) extends his arm and initiates illegal head contact with Brunson (NYK) that affects his SQBR during the drive.
Champagnie (WAS) reaches in and initiates contact with Brunson's (NYK) arm after he has gathered, which alters his driving shot attempt.
Brogdon (WAS) goes to, not through, Bridges' (NYK) space and marginal contact occurs as Brogdon (WAS) releases away during the drive.
Brunson (NYK) and Sarr (WAS) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Carrington  (WAS) touches the ball last prior to going out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to NYK.
Coulibaly (WAS) extends his arm toward Brunson's (NYK) path and marginal contact occurs to his chest, during the drive.
Hart (NYK) avoids making contact with the ball while still inside the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Bridges (NYK) steps to his left into Coulibaly's (WAS) path and marginal foot to foot contact occurs at the end of the drive.
Anunoby (NYK) legally contests Coulibaly's (WAS) jump shot attempt.

Hart (NYK) gathers the rebound with 1.1 on the clock and asks for a timeout, which is granted. After the officials came together, it was correctly determined that 0.8 should be put back on the game clock.
Towns (NYK) grazes Coulibaly's (WAS) forearm as he completes his intended pass, and the contact is marginal.
Hart (NYK) is firming up over his left foot in Carrington's (WAS) path when marginal upper-body contact occurs during the pick.
Towns (NYK) jumps from point A to point B into Sarr's (WAS) body as he contests and initiates contact that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Towns (NYK) engages and disengages with Champagnie (WAS) off-ball and marginal contact occurs as Champagnie moves to defend the shot.
Champagnie (WAS) extends to contest and initiates contact with Brunson's (NYK) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Sarr (WAS) and Towns (NYK) mutually engage and separate as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Anunoby (NYK) turns as he jumps to contest and initiates contact with Coulibaly's (WAS) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) steps out of bounds while in possession of the ball. Possession is correctly awarded to WAS.
Sarr (WAS) is late to establish a screening position as he extends laterally into Bridges' (NYK) path during the off-ball screen.
Coulibaly (WAS) reaches in and makes contact to Brunson's (NYK) arm that affects his SQBR.
Bridges (NYK) commits a take foul on Brogdon (WAS), and the contact occurs prior to Brogdon's upward shooting motion.
Carrington (WAS) commits a take foul on Brunson (NYK).
Hart (NYK) commits a take foul on Brogdon (WAS).
Brogdon's (WAS) free throw attempt does not make contact with the rim, and a free throw violation should have been assessed.
Towns (NYK) and Valančiūnas (WAS) mutually engage and disengage as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Coulibaly (WAS) commits a take foul on Hart (NYK).
